name: Watashi no Kare wa Shindeiru.
original_name: 私のカレは死んでいる。
source:
----Let us start the continuation to this Dead End.

The setting is a fictional town called Manjuusaka.
When the protagonist, Amaboshi Rinne, who possesses high spiritual power wakes up one morning, she is met with a pure-white ghost.
That ghost, who just barely preserves a human shape----
"He" has lost memories of his life. He knows not even who he is.
...All he remembers is that the heroine is his "fated person".
The heroine can assess information from things belonging to the dead and places with strong memories; using that power, she helps "Him" in collecting his lost memories.

But what first comes to light is that "His" true identity, as well as the man who thinks of the heroine as "fated person" - consist of four.
"His" true identity is only one among the four candidates...
Sakai Ikuma, Ninomiya Yuuichi, Nouke Ren, and Osaragi Katsuya.
As they start collecting the memories of these candidates, it becomes that inside "Him" lives four people.

For the sake of identifying "his" true identity and letting him pass on safely, begin the days the heroine spends with "him", but----

(Translation of the official site summary.)
translation:
----让我们开始这个死胡同的延续吧。

故事背景是一个虚构的小镇曼珠萨卡。
拥有高灵力的主角天星轮回一天早上醒来时，遇到了一只纯白的鬼魂。
那个鬼魂，勉强保留着人形——
“他”失去了一生的记忆。他甚至不知道自己是谁。
……他只记得女主角是他的“命中注定的人”。
女主角可以从属于死者的事物和具有强烈记忆的地方评估信息；利用这种力量，她帮助“他”收集他失去的记忆。

但首先暴露出来的是“他”的真实身份，以及将女主角视为“命中注定的人”的男人——由四人组成。
“他”的真实身份只是四位候选人中的一位……
酒井生熊、二宫雄一、野克莲、大荒木克也。
当他们开始收集这些候选人的记忆时，“他”体内住着四个人。

为了查明“他”的真实身份，并让他平安过世，女主角与“他”度过的日子开始了，但是——

（官方网站摘要的翻译。）
